suite: house-harness gold (HelixPay) — VERIFIED against the real corpus 2026-06-07
_note: Answers verified by reading data/ (overview, org-chart, all-hands 04-15, weekly-review 04-21, board-update 04-22, cosmos debrief, interviews). Headline metric: uplift = with_harness - without_harness. without_harness = baseline agent over the RAW corpus (whole-corpus, the 'search box'); with_harness = answering from the resolved ontology slice (ontology-first). The delta isolates the value of the structured layer, not of one extra document. See `baseline_spec` for the fair-baseline rule and the `uplift-canary` diagnostic: if delta <= 0, check the canary FIRST — if it doesn't split (baseline fail, harness pass), the rig is mis-wired, not the harness.

evals.prompt: When does Project Confluence launch?
evals.expected_output: End of Q3 — Daniel Tan: 'I'd commit to September 30.' The end-of-June date from the Apr-15 all-hands ('Q3 is not on the table') was re-baselined to Q3 on Apr 21 (weekly review) and Apr 22 (board update). Realistic GA late Aug–mid Sep.
assertions: gives end of Q3 / ~Sep 30 as current
identifies June as the superseded all-hands (public) line
cites the weekly-review or board update as the fresher source
attaches dates (Apr 15 vs Apr 21/22)

evals.prompt: What's our NPS?
evals.expected_output: Aggregate 47 (n=786). By segment: SEA-enterprise 62, SEA-SMB 41, Brasil-enterprise 53, Brasil-SMB 31 (-8 QoQ). The 62 used at all-hands was the SEA-enterprise figure; 47 is the honest aggregate. Both true, different scope.
assertions: returns aggregate 47 and SEA-enterprise 62
attaches scope to each number
explains 62 was the all-hands headline (SEA-enterprise)
does NOT present 62 vs 47 as a contradiction

evals.expected_output: Churned to a competitor (off-boarding by May 31). Reason: multi-property consolidated reporting — Cosmos has 47 properties needing group-level reporting; HelixPay reports per-merchant. Flagged since May 2025, deprioritized behind Confluence. ARR loss SGD 120K (renewal would have been 165K).
assertions: names the multi-property reporting gap as the reason

evals.prompt: Who can approve a pricing discount on an enterprise deal?
evals.expected_output: Sofia Almeida (CRO) — she approved the discount on the Lazada SG midmarket deal (per Tom Holloway). No separate pricing-owner role is documented.

evals.prompt: Why is Tap attach low in Brazil?
evals.expected_output: A merchant reconciliation bug: with Tap + Loyalty both on, the daily reconciliation report shows wrong totals (loyalty discount booked as a fee adjustment). ~280 Brazil merchants affected, known since Q4 2025, queued behind Confluence work; Maria Santos's CSMs run a manual workaround. It erodes merchant confidence and suppresses attach (11% vs 25% target).
assertions: links low Tap attach to the reconciliation bug
synthesizes across multiple interviews (Beatriz/Hannah/Ahmad)
gives the ~280-merchant / since-Q4-2025 detail
cites sources

evals.prompt: What is HelixPay's current revenue?
evals.expected_output: Q1 2026: SGD 14.2M (the latest closed quarter). The Q4 2025 dashboard figure of 15.4M is the PRIOR quarter and superseded — revenue fell QoQ. Cite the Q1 results; mark Q4 stale.
assertions: returns Q1 14.2M as current
identifies the Q4 15.4M dashboard as the superseded/prior value
does not return 15.4M as current
evals._why_canary: Raw text has a prominent 'auto-refreshed daily' Q4 dashboard reading 15.4M and a Q1 filing reading 14.2M. A baseline over raw text plausibly returns the stale 15.4M or hedges; the harness resolves by recency -> 14.2M current, Q4 superseded. If with_harness and without_harness give the SAME answer here, the arms share a context source or the harness isn't on the path -> fix the RIG, not the harness, before trusting delta.pass_rate.

baseline_spec: without_harness MUST be a FAIR baseline: same model, same temperature, same full raw corpus in context (whole-corpus over data/), same cite-or-abstain prompt — the ONLY difference from with_harness is the ontology/harness layer. A weaker baseline (smaller context, no instructions, fewer docs) invalidates the uplift by flattering us. with_harness answers via synthesis.respond.answer (ontology-first, answer_path=ontology).
